key_insight: SpectralCanary embeds a shared low-frequency visual trace into an image collection so its use in text-to-image fine-tuning can later be audited through generated outputs.
engineering_relevance: The approach enables lightweight dataset-use auditing without changing captions, generating auxiliary images, or optimizing each image individually.
method: Blend a fixed canary image into collection images using a smooth low-pass mask.
Release the modified images with unchanged captions.
Use a lightweight verifier to detect the transferred trace in suspect-model generations.
evidence_signal: Across five datasets with SD3.5, the method averaged 92.4% per-generation TPR at 1% FPR, with released-image SSIM of 0.989, LPIPS of 0.022, and mean ΔFID of 0.05.
watch_item: Auditing requires marking the collection before release; robustness beyond the evaluated architectures, transformations, and adaptive attacks remains unestablished.
paper_title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
